beta.notes:
Fast start: a splash while WireProof loads; the window is usable as soon as it shows (the catalog snapshot serves at once, its database check runs in the background); the database is woken at launch.
Parts Database: opens at once with a loading bar; its dropdowns come from the catalog snapshot; a lookup edit reloads the catalog.
Photos are read when shown; the Excel library loads on export.
Also: a device lists every cavity of its connectors; junction shape switch is undoable; segments keyed by GUID; database notices on the status bar; a Parts Database save shows its reload.
